Title: Account locks after 5 consecutive failed login attempts
Steps: Enter aurora.shopper@example.com in the email field; enter a wrong password and submit; repeat five times
Expected Result: After the 5th consecutive failure the account is locked; the shopper must reset the password or try again later; no authentication is attempted and further logins are rejected

Title: Account is locked after five bad password submissions
Steps: Submit a wrong password five times in a row on staging.aurora-shop.dev/login
Expected Result: The account locks after the fifth failure; further logins are rejected until reset

Title: Account unlocks automatically after 30 minutes
Steps: Lock the account with five bad logins; wait 30 minutes; sign in with the correct password
Expected Result: The account is unlocked automatically and the shopper reaches the dashboard; the counter is reset

Title: Locked shopper regains access after the half-hour window
Steps: Trigger lockout; wait for the unlock window to pass; log in again
Expected Result: Login succeeds after 30 minutes without a password reset

Title: Locked account rejects any further login attempts
Steps: Lock the account; try to log in with the correct password
Expected Result: No authentication is attempted; the locked-account message is shown and no session is issued

Title: No login succeeds while the account stays locked
Steps: Lock the account; submit valid credentials
Expected Result: The attempt is rejected and the failed-attempt counter does not increase

Title: SQL injection in the login email field is rejected
Steps: Enter `' OR '1'='1` in the email field and submit
Expected Result: The login is rejected with a generic validation message; no account is authenticated; the Postgres audit log records no successful authentication

Title: Malicious SQL input in the email box is blocked
Steps: Type an SQL payload into the login email field; submit any password
Expected Result: The login is rejected with a generic validation message; the Postgres audit log shows no successful authentication

Title: 4 failed attempts do not lock the account and the 5th within 15 minutes does
Steps: Submit a wrong password four times; then submit the correct password; then fail once more
Expected Result: After four failures login still works; at the fifth consecutive failure within the window the account locks

Title: Boundary of four versus five failures inside the window
Steps: Fail four times within 15 minutes and confirm login works; fail a fifth time
Expected Result: The fifth consecutive failure locks the account

Title: Failed attempts older than 15 minutes fall outside the window
Steps: Record four failures more than 15 minutes ago; fail once more now
Expected Result: The new failure counts as the first in the window and the account does not lock

Title: Stale failures outside the 15-minute window are ignored
Steps: Age four failures past 15 minutes; submit one more bad password
Expected Result: Login with the correct password still succeeds

Title: Guest checkout shows the order total before payment
Steps: Add SKU-1042 to the bag as a guest; go to checkout
Expected Result: The order total with shipping is shown before the payment step

Title: Wishlist saves items for the next visit
Steps: Save SKU-2087 to the wishlist; close the browser; reopen staging.aurora-shop.dev
Expected Result: The saved item is still in the wishlist on the next visit

Title: Search returns matching SKUs for a partial term
Steps: Type 'lamp' in the storefront search box
Expected Result: Matching SKUs are listed within two seconds

Title: Checkout rejects an expired card with a clear message
Steps: Pay with an expired test card on the staging checkout
Expected Result: The payment is declined and a clear card error is shown

Title: Password reset email arrives within a minute
Steps: Request a reset for aurora.shopper@example.com
Expected Result: The reset email arrives within one minute with a working link

Title: Cart keeps quantities after a page refresh
Steps: Set SKU-1042 quantity to 3; refresh the page
Expected Result: The cart still shows quantity 3 for SKU-1042

Title: Admin console lists recent orders newest first
Steps: Open the admin console order list
Expected Result: Orders are sorted newest first with ten rows per page

Title: Stock count decreases after a completed purchase
Steps: Note the stock for SKU-3091; buy one unit
Expected Result: The stock count for SKU-3091 decreases by one
